_comment: Copy this to a project root as `.arc` to opt that project into ARC enforcement. Its presence is the switch: no .arc, no hooks fire, nothing changes.

checks._comment: The commands that must have actually run before a file-modifying turn may end. Matched on the first two words, so arguments don't defeat the gate. Remove any you don't have - an empty checks block disables the Stop gate for this project.

test_paths: _comment: globs, relative to the project root or a bare filename. While a fix is in progress these cannot be edited, so a run cannot weaken the check that gates it.
